raw_block.rationale: Create a coordinated airline package: one helper reads the coupled itinerary, bag, allowance, and fee-schedule record; a dependent terminal helper performs deterministic classification and arithmetic, including the higher-of excess-fee rule.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: bag_lengths
inputs.question: In current item order, what is each bag's length in inches?

inputs.name: bag_widths
inputs.question: In current item order, what is each bag's width in inches?

inputs.name: bag_heights
inputs.question: In current item order, what is each bag's height in inches?

inputs.name: bag_weights
inputs.question: In current item order, what is each bag's weight in pounds?

inputs.name: personal_item_limits
inputs.question: What length, width, and height limits does the current source state for a personal item?

inputs.name: carry_on_limits
inputs.question: What length, width, and height limits does the current source state for a carry-on bag?

inputs.name: checked_base_fees
inputs.question: For the current route and cabin, what base fees apply to successive checked-bag positions from first through the greatest position the current items could occupy, after applicable complimentary checked-bag allowances?

inputs.name: checked_weight_limits
inputs.question: For those successive checked-bag positions, what standard weight limit applies before an overweight charge, accounting for any higher limit limited to complimentary First or Business bags?

inputs.name: overweight_upper_bounds
inputs.question: What are the source's successive upper pound bounds for the three overweight bands?

inputs.name: overweight_band_fees
inputs.question: For the current route and cabin, what fees correspond to those three overweight bands in increasing-weight order?

inputs.name: oversize_upper_bounds
inputs.question: What are the standard-size, first-oversize, and maximum accepted total-dimension bounds in inches?

inputs.name: oversize_band_fees
inputs.question: For the current route, what fees apply to the two oversize bands in increasing-size order?

skill.intent: Produce the coupled current-source baggage facts and applicable route-and-cabin fee schedule needed for deterministic fee calculation.

outputs.description: Coupled current baggage facts and applicable fee schedule.
outputs.name: record

reads.question: Read the current itinerary, cabin, ordered bag measurements, ticket price, carried-item limits, checked-bag schedule, weight allowances, and route-specific excess-fee bands as one coupled record.
reads.source_locator: current RuleArena Airline source_text, facts, and question

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Extract the one-personal-item and one-carry-on dimensional limits used to determine which current items must be checked.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Extract the applicable base fee and weight allowance for each successive checked-bag position under the current route and cabin.

source_provenance.quote: Your personal item like a purse or small handbag must fit under the seat in front of you. Dimensions should not exceed 18 x 14 x 8 inches (45 x 35 x 20 cm).
The total size of your carry-on, including the handles and wheels, cannot exceed 22 x 14 x 9 inches (56 x 36 x 23 cm) and must fit in the sizer at the airport.
We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.

inputs.name: record
inputs.question: What coupled current baggage facts and applicable fee schedule were extracted?

skill.intent: Calculate the exact integer ticket plus all current bag fees from a coupled airline baggage case record.

outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus fees for every current bag.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: simultaneous_excess_rule

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

premises.question: When a checked bag is both overweight and oversize, which excess charge is added?

origin.quote: You can bring only one carry-on item along with your personal item.

source_obligations.statement: After applying the available carried-item allowances, assign remaining items successive checked-bag positions.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: If the same checked bag is both overweight and oversize, add only the higher excess fee to its base checked-bag fee.

source_provenance.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size. The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
